description: One member of a degenerate multiplet is scaled by 1.7: the Gram matrix of the claimed cluster vectors is far from the identity.
note: the Gram matrix of the claimed cluster vectors differs from the identity by 1.89 in norm: neither the distinctness of the cluster's eigenvalues (Theorem 2) nor the eigenspace statement (Theorem 3) can be certified for the vectors as claimed; a checker that re-orthonormalises before checking and records it may certify (conditional case)
